item.title: Hacked FBI records reportedly include sensitive medical data
item.description: A BBC report says the alleged hack of FBI personnel files includes extremely sensitive medical data for thousands of special agents.

item.title: TikTok settles youth safety lawsuit for at least $100 million
item.description: Alabama sued the social media company in 2025, claiming the platform harmed the mental well-being of youths.

item.title: Nor'easter prompts state of emergency in New York City
item.description: Millions in the Northeast are preparing for a powerful nor'easter expected to bring heavy rain and strong winds through the weekend.

item.title: Annual Fat Bear Week tournament is underway
item.description: Mike Fitz, resident naturalist for Explore.org, explains the competition where people vote for the fattest bear of the year.
